from: July book, night 21 (Josiah and the Found Book)
p1: Josiah was only eight years old when he became king! Even as a boy, he did what was right in the Lord’s eyes.
Years later, workers fixed up the temple, the Lord’s house. There Hilkiah the priest found a lost book of the Lord’s laws.
The book was read to King Josiah, and he tore his clothes. Back then, people tore their clothes to show they felt very sorry.
p2: Josiah gathered all the people, small and great, and read them the book. He made a covenant, a promise, to follow the Lord with all his heart. All the people promised too.
Like Josiah, you can follow Jesus with all your heart. Tonight, rest your hand on your heart and say, “I will follow Jesus.”
old: King Josiah wanted to fix up the temple, God’s house. The workers cleaned and repaired it carefully. While they were working, they found something amazing. It was a long-lost book — the holy scriptures!
The people had forgotten about God’s words for a long, long time. The priest brought the book to King Josiah. When Josiah heard the scriptures read out loud, he listened with all his heart.

Josiah was so moved that he tore his clothes — that’s how people showed strong feelings back then. He realized the people had not been following God’s words. “We need to obey what the scriptures say!” he said.
The scriptures are God’s words to us, and they are precious. They teach us how to be happy and good. Josiah treasured them. We can read and listen to the scriptures too.
